target.artifact: runtime projection refs in queue read_scope

title: Make runtime projection refs branch-explicit
problem: Prepared universal-work read scopes include repo-relative agent-runtime projection paths such as agent-runtime/manifest.json and agent-runtime/convergence.json. Those live projection artifacts are served from gh-pages rather than main. A worker resolving the unqualified path against main can receive 404 and incorrectly treat current runtime evidence as absent, while the same artifact resolves successfully on gh-pages. This creates avoidable context divergence between otherwise identical /wc workers.
mission: Make runtime-projection references consumed by universal workers resolve deterministically to their authoritative branch or public runtime URL, without changing authority semantics or promoting projection state into Current/Human Accepted/Served truth.
acceptance: Every runtime projection ref consumed by prepared universal work resolves deterministically to its authoritative branch or public URL.
A worker must not interpret a main-branch 404 for agent-runtime manifest/convergence/epoch as source absence when gh-pages owns the projection.
Queue/compiler or resolver emits branch-qualified references and tests cover main 404 plus gh-pages success.
No authority or Served/Current/Human Accepted state is promoted by resolving a projection.

goal_relevance.reason: Identical fresh /wc workers should reconstruct the same durable posture; branch-ambiguous L1 refs can make equivalent workers see different source availability.

information_gain.reason: Turns a silent 404/source-absence ambiguity into an explicit, testable source-resolution contract.

regression_prevention.reason: Prevents future generated queues from reintroducing unqualified runtime projection paths that only resolve on gh-pages.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Workers can recover current runtime context without human explanation of which branch owns generated runtime artifacts.

candidate_write_scope: runtime/queue or context compiler source that emits universal-worker runtime refs
tests for branch-aware runtime projection resolution
falsification: All prepared runtime projection references already carry an unambiguous branch/public URL contract at their actual consumption point.
A repository-relative main-branch miss is already deterministically retried against the authoritative runtime projection source by binding code rather than worker convention.
Changing reference resolution would introduce more ambiguity than it removes or would cross an authority boundary.

source_freshness.observation: repo-relative fetch of agent-runtime/manifest.json on main returned 404 during this worker cycle; the same path on gh-pages returned agent-runtime-manifest/v3 with live main_head and epoch.
